home_intro: This app demonstrates the FormKrafter stack consumed from React through the generated wrappers: the drag & drop builder, the form renderer, rules and validation.
playground_intro: Build a form with the palette, configure bricks in the property panel, then try it live in the preview below.
playground_preview_hint: Build a form above to preview it here.
ex_simple_intro: The number one production case: a spec saved in your database, rendered with FkFormRender, validated and submitted.
ex_wizard_intro: A stepper with per-step validation, locked step navigation and a final submit button.
ex_i18nform_intro: Labels, options and error messages carry per-locale en/fr values — switch the app language and the form follows, errors included.
ex_remote_intro: Options fetched from a public API with server-side search, plus a second select depending on the first through URL interpolation.
ex_grid_intro: A data grid with per-row validation and a minimum row count — validate to see contacts[0].name style errors.
ex_auth_intro: A token injected through the data prop and referenced as _authToken in the request headers — and provably absent from the submitted payload.
ex_auth_proof: The select options below display exactly what the data source received:
ex_rules_intro: Show, disable and compute fields from other answers — json-logic by default, sandboxed JavaScript when needed. Pick “Other”, tick the checkbox, set quantity above 10.
ex_server_intro: The submitted data is revalidated inside a TanStack server function with validateFormData from the core — compare both verdicts.
ex_custom_intro: A star-rating brick registered at runtime with registerBrick, validated and rendered like any built-in.
ex_theming_intro: The same form under default tokens and inside a branded dark subtree — pure CSS, scoped with data-fk-theme.
